title: Microbiome of sludge pit in Penaeus vannamei brackishwater farm
description: Sludge pits or sludge collection units are designed and maintained in Penaeus vannamei brackishwater farm to collect uneaten feed, feces, dead palnkton. The aim of study is to explore the diversity and abundance of microbiota in sludge pits of Penaeus vannamei brackishwater farm
samples: Metagenome or environmental sample from sludge metagenome
environmental sample from a non-urban site
